specimenMappings.decision: Native depiction is evidence; source properties do not become runtime node selectors or an invented public state prop.

decisions: DataTable is the official Table+TanStack guide recipe, not an invented exported widget root. Caller semantic data-part marks only recipe-owned toolbar, filter, selection, sort action, empty/error/count and page navigation. Complete Table CSS explicitly owns all native table row/cell/head/caption geometry; Button/Input CSS own those actual source controls. The recipe retains native compact 16px selection affordance and uses bounded readable spacing/filter width decisions instead of558px native specimen width. Actual selected row data-state and native checkbox are independent from sorting/filtering/paging/visibility states. Stable getRowId binds checkbox names and state to records; current aria-sort belongs to real scoped header. Empty colSpan follows visible column count. Error is caller feedback and does not erase controlled feature state. DashboardDataTableBlock is explicitly a separate frozen application composition, not rendered extra anatomy. Native table semantics stay native; no fictitious ARIA grid navigation, record schema or backend lifecycle.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
